activities.name: Whimpering Wastes
activities.description: Assemble unique lineups and equip distinct Tokens to conquer challenging levels.

activities.name: Pioneer Podcast
activities.description: During Pioneer Podcast, you can obtain Podcast EXP by completing Podcast Tasks to increase the Podcast Level and win various rewards.

activities.name: Gifts of Starpath
activities.description:
Before the "Gifts of Starpath" event ends, Convene in the Reverb Resonator Convene to accumulate Convene attempts and unlock corresponding tier rewards.

Please note that your progress in the current "Gifts of Starpath" event is separate from your progress in the Version 3.5 "Gifts of Starpath" event.

activities.name: Gifts of Bygone Dreams: 7-Day Login Event
activities.description: During the event, log in to claim the day's login rewards from the event page.

activities.name: Second Coming of Solaris: Unwritten Dreams Leisure Event
activities.description:
Use Schedules to plan your weekly routine. Take classes, do extracurricular activities, and work part-time jobs to raise your stats and earn various rewards. Remember to schedule enough breaks to avoid getting overly fatigued.

Different growth paths, experiences, and story choices all lead to different Story Endings and Companion Endings. Once you meet the required conditions, you can choose a "future" of your own.

After reaching an ending, you can start your school life anew to try different choices, unlock more story branches, and experience other Story Endings.

activities.name: Lahai-Roi Blocks; Turnabout Leisure Event
activities.description: Each stage has two difficulties: Normal and Hard. Finish the Normal difficulty to unlock the Hard challenge. Complete the goals of each stage to earn rewards.

activities.name: Endstate Matrix
activities.description: In Endstate Matrix, deploy Resonators and select a Power Circuit before starting a high-difficulty challenge. Endstate Matrix progresses through Challenge Cycles. Each Challenge Cycle spans across multiple Challenge Phases, which reset with version updates. Rewards are offered independently for Challenge Cycles and Challenge Phases.

activities.name: Whimpering Wastes
activities.description: Assemble unique lineups and equip distinct Tokens to conquer challenging levels.

activities.name: [Bountiful Crescendo] Limited-Time Material Double Drop Event
activities.description: Spend Waveplates to claim double rewards after completing a Simulation or Forgery Challenge.

activities.name: Lollo Campaign: Groundwork Featured Commission Event
activities.description: During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps. Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

activities.name: Dreamfield Odyssey Combat Event
activities.description: In the Dreamfield Odyssey event, you can select 1 Primary Resonator and 2 Secondary Resonators to take on a series of challenges. The event consists of multiple Marchstones, each containing several Nodes. At the start of each Marchstone, you can choose which Sediments to bring into battle.

activities.name: Whither the Wind: Limited Time Login Event
activities.description: After the event begins, log in to the game daily to claim your daily sign-in rewards.

activities.name: [Chord Cleansing] Limited-Time Echo Double Drop Event
activities.description: Spend Waveplates to claim double rewards after completing a Tacet Suppression challenge.
